title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
description: A familiar melody using a small group of adjacent keys.
learningFocus: Right-hand note reading, even rhythm and simple phrasing.
practiceTip: Start with the right hand at 60 BPM. Add the left-hand bass notes when the melody feels comfortable.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Ode to Joy
composer: Ludwig van Beethoven · theme from Symphony No. 9
description: A clear melody with repeated phrases.
learningFocus: Stepwise motion, repetition and musical shaping.
practiceTip: Notice the dotted rhythm at phrase endings. Keep the repeated notes even and relax at each cadence.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Hot Cross Buns
description: A very short tune with just three melody notes.
learningFocus: Finding E–D–C, counting and playing steadily.
practiceTip: Use right-hand fingers 3–2–1 on E–D–C. Count all four beats of each long C.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Frère Jacques
description: Symmetrical phrases make the melody easy to remember.
learningFocus: Five-finger position, repeated phrases and coordinating two hands.
practiceTip: Play each repeated phrase the same way. Slow down the eighth notes before adding the left hand.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
description: A familiar tune makes melodic intervals easy to hear.
learningFocus: Melodic intervals, phrase repetition and adding a bass accompaniment.
practiceTip: Look ahead for the opening jump from C to G. Let every two-measure phrase feel connected.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Jingle Bells — simplified
description: The familiar chorus has clear, recurring note groups.
learningFocus: Reading small note groups and maintaining a pulse.
practiceTip: This is a simplified chorus. Keep the repeated E notes light and count through the long notes.
arrangement: PianoPath simplified chorus · even-note melody with bass accompaniment

title: When the Saints Go Marching In
description: A strong beat supports a predictable melody.
learningFocus: Rhythmic consistency, rests and simple accompaniment.
practiceTip: Listen to the pickup before starting. Keep counting through the rests; the left hand supplies the steady foundation.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: Au Clair de la Lune
description: A slow, lyrical melody encourages a singing tone.
learningFocus: Legato touch and shaping a melody.
practiceTip: Connect the melody gently and avoid rushing the half notes. Practise the middle phrase separately before playing the whole song.
arrangement: PianoPath beginner arrangement · melody with simple bass notes

title: C major five-finger song
description: An original study built entirely from C–D–E–F–G.
practiceTip: Place each hand over C–D–E–F–G. Keep the hands relaxed and use one finger per key.

title: Allegro in C Major, Op. 1 No. 4
description: A short classical piece with balanced phrases.
learningFocus: Reading, controlled articulation and simple formal structure.
practiceTip: Learn the two eight-measure sections slowly. The score below unfolds the repeats and D.C. al Fine as A–A–B–B–A; finish after the final A.
arrangement: Original pitches and rhythms · repeats and D.C. al Fine written out
